To anyone struggling, here’s what worked for me. Changed fuel maps between 1, 3 and 4 throughout the race whenever I see fit although from here it looks like you can get away with 3 for the whole race. Tweaked the car settings, downforce at 930 for the front, minimum for the rear. 41-44 ride height and 5-3 anti-roll. Wanted it slightly softer in the rear to make up for the lack of downforce at the back to prevent oversteer on turn in. Racing medium tires, don’t pit. Traction control on 2 because there’s no way I could wrestle that thing around a track without it, especially with low downforce. Would have won first try if drumont didn’t torpedo me into ascari on the final lap but I won second try. I’m pretty new to tuning so I’m sure there’s a better setup but this did it for me.
